Dear Olympia,
I hope this email finds you well!
As part of our Customer Service team's global initiative to clean up our ticketing backlog, we're reaching out to help streamline our open cases.
During a recent review of our ISP ticketing system, we noticed several aging tickets that need a quick status check. We're here to help make this process as smooth as possible for you.
Would you be able to help us confirm:
If the repair/resolution has been completed
Whether any follow-up actions are still pending
Any relevant comments about the current situation
Don't worry about the administrative part - our central Customer Service team will take care of closing the tickets once you confirm their status.
If you could add any brief comments that might be helpful for documentation and provide your confirmation by replying to this email, that would be great!
Thanks so much for your help with this initiative! If you need any assistance or have questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0371299 - ID0371299-DC/Si-D/GR-[MP / ND 170000204] Scramble Screen CRM:00362000005
additional_info.body:
Deam Michele, hello and nice to hear from you.
There are some tickets related to installed SiD in Greece which are open and remain long time.
Regarding this specific SiD, an onsite intervention is planned for HMI replacement due to known delamination issue and also for the annual service.
If we replace the HMI, do we need to consider also DC cable (or HMI controller update)? Or after replacing the HMI, issues will be solved ?
I suggest closing this ticket and as soon as we are onside (within the next couple of weeks)in case  we need any support, we will submit a new ticket.
What do you think ?

additional_info.subject: RE: 0371299 - ID0371299-DC/Si-D/GR-[MP / ND 170000204] Scramble Screen CRM:00362000005
additional_info.body:
I apologize for wrong feedback. This HMI will not be replaced; we will be onsite for the annual service only.
Scramble HMI didn’t appear again, since previous August.
The SiD is out of warranty, and the owner didn’t accept to pay for DP cable + services until now.
If he will, we will replace it otherwise we will provide only the annual service.
We can close this ticket.
Olympia
